Act, No. 48 of 2009
Subject to the provision of the Act, any other written

column3: law, the Corporation shall have the power —

column4: to  submit  proposals  for  the  development  of  the
area ;
to provide services required by the villages and to
perform the duties to their satisfaction ;
to  hold  the  documents  of  Corporation  in  safe
custody and to secure the same ;
to receive subscriptions, grants, donations, gifts from
sources in Sri Lanka or abroad ;
to  obtain  loans  on  such  terms  and  conditions  as
may be approved by the executive committee for
the purpose of carrying out the objects ; and
to do all other acts and things as are necessary or
expedient to the carrying out of the objects of the
Corporation.

and voting to make rules, not inconsistent with the provisions
of this Act or any other written law, for the following matters—

column4: the  admission,  classification  or  expulsion  of
members;
for  the  election  of  office  bearers,  the  Executive
Committee  and  the  conduct  of  the  duties  of  the
various  officers,  agents  and  servants  of  the
Corporation;
for the procedure to be followed in the transaction
